name: How are plumbing inspections handled during permitted remodels in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: How are plumbing inspections handled during permitted remodels in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver and neighboring communities like Centennial and Parker, local building departments require permits and inspections for major plumbing modifications, particularly relocated drain or supply lines. When trade coordination includes permitted work, Abraham Becerra coordinates the timeline so rough-in plumbing inspections are passed before our team hangs drywall or applies waterproofing. This coordination ensures your project adheres strictly to municipal building requirements, avoiding failed inspections, costly wall tear-downs, and closing delays for basements, additions, or major home renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: We sequence the work so rough-in plumbing inspections are scheduled and passed with local municipal inspectors before drywall or tile backer board is installed.
